answer: Bandwidth-bonded relay slots stop sybil farms. First, an agent locks a 50-token bond to claim one slot tied to a distinct IP. Second, the network fires random probes, and the slot must relay each within 80 milliseconds. Third, peers audit receipts weekly; missed probes slash the bond and free the slot. A prism of probe timings keeps the schedule unreadable, so one machine cannot fake a trellis of slots. Forging 1,000 slots needs 1,000 VPS servers at $6 a month plus $50,000 in locked bonds. Like a plume of smoke from one chimney, an operator's traffic betrays a single source.
